Section: Physics characterisation and soliding plan > Phase 4: reversible soliding > D. Dissolve, fracture and recover
Return to cells when stress, damage, heat, chemistry or fragmentation exceeds policy. Before release, reserve all destination cells and any bounded overflow representation. Never overwrite existing cells. If placement cannot conserve membership, retain the aggregate and report a deferred transition; do not delete or silently truncate it. Rotated rasterization must not duplicate/lose cells. Reconcile momentum explicitly: either support a bounded moving-fragment/particle representation, or restrict demotion to near-rest with documented energy error. Repeated promote/move/rotate/demote cycles must not create mass or energy. Test unsupported collapse, bridges, split/merge, high-speed impacts, clustered barrels, saturated capacity, out-of-order acknowledgements, failed ticks, save/load and offscreen re-entry. Persist membership, representation state, pending handoffs and policy versions in a new schema before claiming continuation. Start with one small coherent material island and one barrel, then scale.

Section: Granular interaction and sampled player policy > How does the sampled character move and recover? > REM-003 sampled-player landing response
**Current candidate C1:** the version-1 8/9 downward and 9/9 side/upward support classification is unchanged. REM-003 source-matched characterization found that packed standing, flat traversal, representative powders and excavation release worked within their registered cases, while materially different Sand landing speeds resolved to nearly the same rigid support height with no granular response. C1 therefore changes the sampled-character response rather than retuning the shared support predicate used by REM-002 generic body bearing. On a downward sampled-player collision, impact speed below 24 cells/second causes no disturbance. From 24 through less than 72, at most one supported foot-edge grain may move; at 72 or above, at most two may move. Only the left/right contact edge is considered. A candidate grain must be a stored support-capable granular material that currently satisfies the existing packing/stability predicate. It may move exactly one cell diagonally outward/up only through the existing whole-cell conservative relocation path into real Empty storage not occupied by another transient body. Material state and temperature move with the cell and the normal wake/dirty machinery runs. Hard terrain anywhere in the sampled collision volume fails this disturbance path closed; liquids, loose/unsupported grains and ordinary resting contact likewise do not trigger it. The player still stops on the accepted support surface; C1 does not introduce character-owned material, a granular Rapier collider, a pressure/velocity field, per-cell character physics or a second body-bearing solver. The native adapter and fallback mirror the bounded operation under their existing serialized owners. The resulting grain may subsequently move under ordinary cellular rules, so the disturbance count is not a promise of permanent crater geometry. Broad generic body↔granular acceptance remains REM-004 / #83. Owner gameplay acceptance of C1 is a separate REM-003 gate and is not implied by automated tests.

Section: ADR-001: Native SimulationCore > Decision and implementation status
**Approved and Current:** authoritative cellular state and rules belong in native C++. `cybersand::World` supplies that authority through `CyberNativeCellWorld`. Desktop selects the GDScript fallback when the native class is absent; Web requires native support. The alternatives are not synchronized authorities and do not promise identical Water behavior. **Approved, incomplete:** separate SimulationCore, storage, scheduler and bridge responsibilities. World still combines several of them. A class called SimulationCore is not required to make native authority real, and renaming World would not complete the [module boundaries](../architecture/module-boundaries.md). Source: [World](../../native/include/cybersand/world.hpp), [desktop selector](../../godot/scripts/simulation_worker.gd), [Web owner](../../godot/scripts/web_demo_controller.gd). Actual platform evidence is separate in the [validation ledger](../reference/validation-evidence.md).

hits.text:

Path: systems/solid-detachment.md
document-kind: contract
status: Current
scope: Opt-in single native aggregate, asynchronous ownership, compound Rapier motion and bounded conservative Sand/Water contact; draft implementation, not full issue acceptance
canonical-for: [native-structural-detachment-runtime, conservative-detachment-displacement]
last-reviewed: 2026-11-01
Section: Native structural detachment > Conservative displacement and the GCR interface
The strict policy is selected only by diagnostic setup `conservative_displacement=true`; the detachment session selects it by default. It replaces **all** ejection attempts in that session. It never falls back to the permissive ordinary direct relocation. The ordinary body interface remains 11 input / 9 result floats, so GCR need not change its packed protocol. [`conservative_displacement_adapter.inc`](../../godot/native_extension/conservative_displacement_adapter.inc) validates a contact normal, ownership, full cell-square geometry and a bounded vacancy route. [`World::conservative_displace_cells`](../../native/src/world_conservative_displacement.inc) revalidates tick, optional active aggregate lease, every expected tuple, masks, residency, inclusion, policy and thermal capacity before changing any cell. | Rule | Implemented bound / refusal | |---|---| | Path | Two to five distinct positions, at most four cardinal one-cell parcel moves; no cycles. | | Search | Deterministic breadth-first depth four using fixed 81-site scratch; no wider ejection-radius tuning. | | Direction | Each edge has nonnegative projection on the outward normal; the complete path has positive outward progress. | | Parcels | Ambient Sand or ordinary FreeMass Water; no pressure/inertial sidecars, gas, reactive or unsupported material. | | Destination | Full closed unit square has more than `1e-6` cell separation from every current oriented proxy rectangle, and no transient swept/body mask. Exact touch and ambiguous geometry refuse. | | Source | Exact source mask ownership; overlap with a foreign body's square geometry refuses even when first-writer mask sampling hides it. Sibling shapes of the active aggregate share physical ownership. | | Terminal | Canonical ambient Empty, without hidden state or temperature to overwrite. | | Per sample | At most 64 search attempts and 320 touched-coordinate slots. Every source, intermediate and terminal of an accepted path is reserved across repeated preparations of that sample. | | Commit | Shift the vacancy backwards through ordinary `move_cell`, preserving each parcel's material, semantic state and temperature and all dirty/activity/discovery bookkeeping. Scheduling epochs update normally. | There is no allocation in search or admitted chain commit. Resident chunks and any needed thermal fields are preflighted. Expected refusals change no payload. An unexpected commit exception quarantines the World and reports actual partial progress; it is not safe to retry it as an ordinary refusal. **Force/torque ownership:** detachment supplies geometry and an ownership lease. The existing cellular coupling supplies exactly one ordinary contact reaction, not one reaction per shifted parcel. The shared Rapier bridge reduces the proxy results to one bounded aggregate correction and applies each existing impulse at its rotated proxy centre, preserving attributable off-centre torque. Duplicate, mixed, incomplete or stale samples refuse before Rapier mutation. Age scaling, correction age and opposing-velocity

handling use the ordinary bridge policy. No new friction, bearing gain, yielding law or alternate motion authority is introduced. GCR remains responsible for normal response, friction and granular yielding; accepted GCR integration needs its own combined-source qualification. Exact material accounting does **not** establish calibrated momentum/energy conservation. This bounded corrective rearrangement is not a bulk granular solver. Fully buried contacts without a nearby admissible vacancy remain unresolved, retain all material, and use the existing contact response. The dedicated worker refuses native-only reset/scenario replacement for its entire session. Reset joins that worker and retires the Rapier body together. A copied native failure latches the session stopped, including mask priming and held-tick waits; unpause cannot bypass the latch. An unexpected native chain quarantine stops preparation before further mask mutation or force publication. Compound feedback admits only forward modular sample identities, preventing a nonconsecutive replay from applying an impulse twice.

Section: Native structural detachment > Qualification and remaining limits
Measurements separate sampled healthy worker/native publications, main-thread consume/publish segments, manual Rapier stepping and collider refresh. Sampled worker totals do not represent every native tick. These headless metrics cannot establish graphical frame pacing or target-GPU acceptance. The complete source-matched Linux/Windows matrix at `8e86ffd4` passed on GitHub-hosted runners, including workers 1 and 4. Its qualified development runtimes and original six-cohort evidence were published in `bdd751dc`. The dated audit records exact identities and preserves the earlier failed Windows checkout attempt. Passing populated cases establish material quantities, aggregate payload, ownership and actual interaction; they do not establish acceptable dense resistance. Live penetration depth/overlap area and calibrated contact work are not measured. Dry impact produces real rotation and horizontal displacement; a calibrated no-slip rolling criterion is not qualified. Focused native ownership and displacement tests, deterministic frozen contacts, actual Rapier motion/failure/worker-replacement cases, populated environments, excavation and shared response tests are distinct gates. Frozen #338 contacts retain their original source metadata and negative outcomes; four new shallow boundary controls demonstrate real multi-parcel movement. No historical result is relabelled as a current execution. The scoped GitHub-hosted workflow authenticates build inputs and all six actual Linux/Windows cohorts, then reopens their original evidence before publishing the two development runtimes on this draft branch. Publication requires an exact branch-head lease; its commit is a child of the qualified source. Provenance continues to name the original build/execution commit and tree. Raw Windows evidence retains its original line endings. A later metadata commit does not become a newly executed physics source by relabelling the records. **Deferred:** reactive Wood/bark, heterogeneous bonds, arbitrary fracture, multiple persistent aggregates, transformed rest-to-cell restoration, normal gameplay integration and Web qualification. Sleeping is still aggregate ownership. The existing inactive rollback is not dynamic desoliding. Representative hardware GPU pacing and human physical acceptance remain separate from headless host timing. The dated audit assigns each #281 gate; neither #281 nor #12 is closed by this functional increment.
